item.title: Iran says five tankers hit naval mines in Strait of Hormuz
item.description: Iran says the tankers caught fire after striking mines; the IEA says the war has caused the largest disruption to oil and gas trade ever.

item.title: Trump, Xi and Putin hold first three-way summit in Shenzhen
item.description: The leaders agreed to talks on nuclear risks and UN reform but set no arms-reduction targets. Ukraine was left out of the declaration.

item.title: Abu Dhabi talks: Russia rules out land swaps with Ukraine
item.description: Russia's negotiator Vladimir Medinsky said Moscow will not accept territorial exchanges; a prisoner swap was agreed.

item.title: COP31 climate summit in Antalya ends without a deal
item.description: The EU rejected a text that did not mention fossil fuels, and the Antalya talks collapsed after record overtime.

item.title: Estonia to close all border crossings with Russia
item.description: Estonia's foreign minister Margus Tsahkna said all crossings with Russia will close from 1 December.

item.title: Ukrainian drones disrupt Russian oil refineries
item.description: Strikes disrupted nine of Russia's largest refineries, cutting Russian refining output in November.
